decisions.reason: As a generic address-autocomplete API in a crowded market, it likely fell short of the firm's aspiration level and is not central enough to justify further attention versus other development projects.

The Austrian gas grid fee database is a niche, domain-specific product that fits a consultancy-style software firm and can be retained with moderate slack while management waits for clearer customer uptake.
Peak load window determination is specialised and closely tied to industrial energy-use problems, so even modest results can meet aspirations if it supports the firm's established customer base.
An end-customer tariff database likely requires continuous data maintenance, and if adoption has been only moderate the shortfall against aspirations would push management to reallocate resources.
Custom web services are strongly aligned with the firm's core programming and consultancy business, so they are most likely to be kept even if stand-alone product results are mixed.

A postal code lookup service is a commoditised utility with limited differentiation, making it the kind of peripheral offer a medium German software firm would drop when reviewing underperforming launches.
